description: From 2027-05-23 the Blends rows in LLN/MN/HN/Cstock were filled with a pasted formula that takes its month from a fixed cell on another sheet (Cstock!RN40) instead of the column's own date, and switches the base-oil-transfer term from the monthly table to the daily-projection column. The month is therefore wrong for the whole tail span.
engine_behaviour: Uses the month of the day being calculated, which is what every other span of the same row does.
action: Confirm with planning that the tail months are meant to follow the calendar, then drop the pasted formulas from the workbook.

description: Production - Out row 46 looks up charge product 8135 in the hydrotreater charge range, but 8135 is not a hydrotreater charge line, so the row evaluates to #N/A for every day. The error propagates through the SUMIF roll-up, leaving product 8135 with no usable production figure anywhere in the workbook.
engine_behaviour: Computes 8135 production from the charge lines that exist, yielding zero rather than an error.
action: Decide whether 8135 should be a hydrotreater charge line or the row should be deleted.
